maintenance_led.reason: Sells new baby and children's apparel (Carter's, OshKosh B'gosh, Skip Hop) to consumers; first-time purchases, not repair or replacement services.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and retail wholesale customers buying children's clothing, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own retail stores, e-commerce and wholesale; Skip Hop and Little Planet were occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Children's apparel is easily substituted; shoppers and wholesale buyers can switch to other brands with little cost or disruption.
